description: Read NightWatch's tradability rating (usable / thin / avoid / insufficient) of every index and ETF perp on the xyz dex, overall and per session, with the one measure that decided it. Optional args: market (one market: rating history, daily session stats, 24-hour profile), session (us_regular|us_extended|asia|weekend), rating (usable|thin|avoid|insufficient), reference_type (broad_index|sector_etf|leveraged_etf|country_etf|other); session, rating and reference_type filter the list and are ignored when market is given. Read-only, no key, free; judged by the house AI, calibration pending. Not news and not advice; venues by code.

market.description: Optional: one market, e.g. 'xyz:SP500'; returns its history and profile

rating.description: Optional list filter: usable, thin, avoid or insufficient

reference_type.description: Optional list filter: broad_index, sector_etf, leveraged_etf, country_etf or other

session.description: Optional list filter: us_regular, us_extended, asia or weekend

name: guardrail_ratings
